steps.title: Dashboard Overview
steps.text: The Surgewave Control dashboard at localhost:5050 is your central hub. It displays 14 configurable widgets showing cluster health, throughput, latency percentiles, and more in real time.

steps.title: Customizable Widgets
steps.text: Widgets can be shown, hidden, and rearranged by dragging. Your layout and theme preferences persist in localStorage across browser sessions. The settings gear icon controls widget visibility.

steps.title: Topic Management
steps.text: The Topics section provides full CRUD operations, a message browser for inspecting data at specific offsets, and a built-in producer for sending test messages. Bulk operations let you manage multiple topics at once.

steps.title: Consumer Groups and Lag
steps.text: Monitor consumer group state, member assignments, and per-partition lag with live charts. The UI supports offset resets to earliest, latest, specific offset, or timestamp for reprocessing scenarios.

steps.title: Monitoring and Alerting
steps.text: The Monitoring section includes metrics dashboards, 7 alert rule types (lag, throughput, latency, broker down, disk, errors, pipeline failure), notification channels, and a performance advisor.
